name: Ishizue Holdings
description: Ishizue Holdings is a business theme for Ishizue Holdings B.V., the privately held group founded in Rotterdam in 1962 by Kenzo Ishizue and Anneke de Vries. It presents the six group companies, the long ownership record, investor notices and the shared-services fees in calm, specific English. Figures, dates and the head-office address at Maaskade 41 stay in euros and in the form the group publishes. A tagline sits beside a rounded photograph that bleeds off the right edge, with a curve-ended timeline line, bracket-phrase marquee rows, a sticky stack of six flat-tinted group-company cards, a parallax harbour photograph, a stone governance band, a white investor panel and an ink owners band. Noto Serif for headings, Noto Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects stop under reduced motion.

fonts.role: display: headings, card headings, menu items, the big numbers (variable 400-700, Latin and Latin Extended subset)
text: body, labels, navigation, marquee phrases, buttons (variable 400-700, Latin and Latin Extended subset)

summary.en: A holding company presented through its history: a rounded head-office photograph, a dated timeline line, bracket-phrase marquee rows and a sticky stack of tinted company cards.
